scope: Read-only design review of proposed operation-owned exact-byte comparison frame; implementation not inspected or accepted here.
assessment: Defensible data-only optimization if every original stream byte is freshly read through EOF and exactly compared; reusing SHA256 digest for identical immutable byte strings is mathematically sound and does not substitute metadata/currentness/native observation.
conditions: Only original deterministic SHA256 implementation eligible. Same callable identity since frame entry is insufficient if a substituted factory is stateful; replacements fall back original uncached behavior.
Capture immutable exact builtin bytes only; reject custom equality/mutable aliases for reuse. Bound number of chunks/objects as well as entries/filebytes/aggregatebytes.

Fresh stream uses original1MiB read requests and EOF/close every call. On mismatch replay only verified-equal original prefix then changed+remaining fresh chunks; truncation/empty/extension handled. Never reopen after partial consumption.

No changed-entry replacement. Original entry hit after intervening change still requires fresh raw reads. Overflow caps only retention and comparison opportunity, never refuse or truncate original reads.
Aggregate cap includes staged candidates plus committed entries. Entry admission requires complete successful EOF and stream close. Failed/partial reads or closes never admitted.
Original factory/update/hexdigest OSError boundaries and BuildError code/message must remain; custom factory path always original semantics.

Nonblocking lock busy/reentrant fallback must not deadlock or restart partially consumed stream. Retirement cannot block on same lock during a read callback; immediately inactive, forbid in-flight publication, clear/defer storage safely.
Fresh private invocation scope overrides/restores ambient cache; copied contexts see inactive after retirement; no membership/currentness/native probe/FS state cached.
regressions: First/middle/last mismatch; shorter ending exactly at original chunk boundary; empty; extension beyond cached EOF; changed then original.
Fresh open/read-all/EOF/close counts remain; same size restoredmtime writable mmap changes still detected by downstream digest checks.
Entry, perfile, aggregate and object-count limits with short reads; cap overflow returns original digest.
Mutable/subclass buffer/path or substituted stateful SHA factory uses original behavior.
Concurrent/reentrant busy fallback and synchronous callback retirement; in-flight copied context after retirement cannot publish retained data.
Open/read/close/factory/update/hexdigest errors preserve exact exception behavior and no partial entries.
performance_estimate: Using sampled28.9% executable_file_digest direct cost and separately measured3.6x stream-hash vs read+memcmp improvement, ideal local-window estimate1/(0.711+0.289/3.6) about1.26x total. This is a short-window bound-like estimate, not whole-run prediction: misses/oversize/entrycaps/concurrency and other runtime-image hashes/native probes reduce benefit. More relevant target than syntax-only work but original900-second actual case rerun still required.
limits: No source changes, no implementation acceptance, no native execution success claim.
